classification: post-comparison exploratory hybrid; not the historical OrbitTrace discovery method and not part of the original fixed4 preregistration
purpose: Combine the complementary ultra-sparse sensitivity of fixed4 with the stronger moderate-member discrimination of the frozen wavelet episode core using a single predeclared null-calibrated union rule.

combination_rule.component_direction: larger raw score is more signal-like
combination_rule.component_p_for_target: within the target solar-longitude bin, (1 + number of calibration scores >= target score) / (N + 1)
combination_rule.component_p_for_calibration: leave-one-out within its solar-longitude bin, (1 + number of other calibration scores >= its score) / N
combination_rule.hybrid_calibration_distribution: the N leave-one-out Tippett statistics in the same solar-longitude bin
combination_rule.final_target_p: (1 + number of hybrid calibration statistics >= target hybrid statistic) / (N + 1)
combination_rule.episode_score_for_auc: Tippett statistic before final p-value conversion

evaluation.freshness_boundary: The earlier 2019-2025 wavelet input audit read only geometry and per-bin counts and explicitly did not read shower labels, coefficients, or detection endpoints. SonotaCo 2022 labelled episode outcomes remain unused before this hybrid freeze.

decision_rules.promote_as_complementary_hybrid: On fresh SonotaCo 2022, hybrid weak-stream AUROC must exceed both components and hybrid recall must not be lower than both components at any k under alpha 0.05.
decision_rules.retain_as_optional_ensemble: Hybrid exceeds the better component in AUROC but fails one no-worse-than-both recall condition, or improves balanced recall without exceeding the better AUROC.
decision_rules.reject_hybrid: Hybrid does not improve the better component's weak-stream AUROC and offers no material recall tradeoff improvement.

claim_boundary.allowed: a newly developed null-calibrated ensemble evaluated prospectively on SonotaCo 2022
prohibited: historical OrbitTrace discovery by the hybrid
replacement of the original fixed4 preregistration
claim that the hybrid beat the full CMOR catalogue survey
selection of another p-value combiner after viewing results
